column1: # GENERATED by scripts/gate_partition_build.py from measured logs.
# Do not hand-edit a verdict: the runner re-checks each module's sha256
# and demotes any module whose bytes no longer match its proof.
# hermetic    every run behind this table used CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""
#   PARALLEL  solo failure set == serial failure set -> wide lane
#   RANKS     same proof, but the module spawns real ranks -> narrow lane,
#             bounded workers so no rank is starved past its timeout
#   SERIAL    proof failed -> one process, one order (reason below)
#   EXCLUDED  cannot run at the desk at all (needs a card) -> neither track,
#             reported on every run so the gate is never read wider than it is
